item.title: Mac gaming is finally getting the overpowered upgrade it deserves
item.description:
📝 For years, Game Porting Toolkit has occupied a strange place in Apple’s software lineup. What exactly is Game Porting Toolkit. Game Porting Toolkit was introduced in 2023 as part of Apple’s efforts to bring more games to the Mac.
🔗 Read more: https://www.macworld.com/article/3189951/apples-latest-game-porting-toolkit-beta-changed-how-i-think-about-mac-gaming.html
